TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
Substitute Narrative and Plans
1622 West Belmont Avenue
From the B1-3 District to C1-3 District

LaSchora Hospitality, LLC is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property
located at 1622 West Belmont Avenue from the B1-3 Neighborhood Shopping District to the C1-3
Neighborhood Commercial District to establish a tavern use with a public place of amusement license in
the existing building and accessory structures at the subject property.

The subject property is located on the block bounded by West Melrose Street on the north, North Lincoln
Avenue on the east, West Belmont Street on the south, and North Paulina Street on the west. The subject
property is irregular in shape and contains approximately 3,317 square feet of site area. The subject
property is improved with a single-story brick commercial building which measures approximately 17 feet
in height, contains approximately 2,184 square feet of commercial space and occupies the majority of the
site; an external walk-in refrigerator; a single-story brick garage used for storage; and a single-story storage
shed. The subject property contains a total of 2,800 square feet of commercial space between the existing
building and accessory structures. The subject property is unoccupied and was most recently operated as
a restaurant. There are no vehicular parking spaces and no bicycle parking spaces at the site, and none
are required. .

The Applicant proposes to establish a tavern use with a public place of amusement license at the subject
property. The Applicant intends to renovate and use the existing structures at the site. No new structures
are proposed.
